name: Arkansas DEQ "Reported Noncompliance Incident Data" (SSO, bypass, upset, unpermitted discharge) search
operator: Arkansas Department of Energy and Environment, Division of Environmental Quality (DEQ)
waters_covered: statewide; location text, no receiving-water field seen (Impact says whether it reached waters, public land, private property)
access_detail: Public search page: a plain HTML form POST (no view state, no session) to https://adeq.state.ar.us/water/enforcement/sso/data.aspx with T_FacilityName, T_NPID, T_MiscSearch, the four type boxes C_SSO/C_Bypass/C_Upset/C_Unpermitted, T_DateStart and T_DateEnd (mm/dd/yyyy, on the day the overflow began), Search=Search; result pages repeat the POST with the hidden PageNo, RecordsPerPage (1 to 100), Sort and SortASC. Ticking two or more type boxes returns nothing (the boxes combine with AND; the cause of the earlier year-wide zero); ticking none returns every type. Each result page states Recs Found and 'Data current as of' (11/13/2026 on 2026-11-14). The search reaches back to 1993 (about 46,000 reports). Text, Excel and PDF exports of a query are offered (download_query.aspx links generated per query).

sample_record.environmental_damage: No Evidence of Adverse Health/Environmental Impact;
sample_record.detail: Web Confirmation Number: 598b8f31-...; Cause: Power Failure; Action Taken: Spread Lime on Affected Area; Type of Overflow: Lift Station Overflow;

cadence: Live: reports filed online appear the next day or sooner. Rule: notify DEQ within 24 hours; 5-day written report for most.
history: The search holds reports from 1993 (most from 2001) to the day before; the Access ZIP is a 2025-08-13 snapshot.
legal_basis: DEQ NPDES permit Part II reporting conditions (24 hours / 5 days)
status_reason: Read by this site: every report whose overflow began since 2025-01-01 (2,449 rows read 2026-11-14), polled by start day with each window's count checked; statewide, dated to the day, usually received the next day; no coordinates, county or receiving-water field.
notes: Also a downloadable Access database NPDES_SSO_web.zip (5 MB, 28 MB .mdb) whose ZIP was last modified 2025-08-13, so it lags the web search; not parsed (no Access tools here). Location text is free text and may include customer addresses: show only to street level and run the name blocklist.

name: Arkansas DEQ NPDES_SSO_web.zip (full Access database)
operator: Arkansas Department of Energy and Environment, Division of Environmental Quality (DEQ)
access_detail: Downloaded to the scratchpad (not the repo): 5,065,954 bytes zipped, NPDES_SSO_web.mdb 28.6 MB, Last-Modified 2025-08-13. Free-text overflow types ("Manhole Overflow", "MH overflow") visible in strings; tables not parsed.
status_reason: A bulk snapshot of the same reports for history before 2025; the ZIP's Last-Modified is still 2025-08-13 (HEAD request 2026-11-14, 5,065,954 bytes); not parsed (Microsoft Access).

name: Arkansas DEQ 24-hour online overflow reporting forms
operator: Arkansas Department of Energy and Environment, Division of Environmental Quality (DEQ)
access_detail: Forms: ?type=b bypass, ?type=d upset, ?type=s SSO, ?type=u unpermitted discharge; email ee.waterenf.sso@arkansas.gov. The page states: "Permittees are required to report any instances of noncompliance that may endanger human health or the environment to DEQ's Water Quality Enforcement. Notification must be made within 24 hours ... an additional 5-Day Written Report is required for ... Any Sanitary Sewer Overflow (SSO), no matter how small".

name: Arkansas DEQ Harmful Algal Bloom current advisories table and news releases
operator: Arkansas Department of Energy and Environment, Division of Environmental Quality (DEQ)
waters_covered: lakes statewide (Lake Hamilton, Huston Lake, Lake June, Lake DeSoto, Lake Poinsett, Lake Alma stream in 2026)
access_detail: The Harmful Algal Blooms page (https://adeq.state.ar.us/water/planning/hab/) and its archive (archive.aspx) are drawn by script from https://adeq.state.ar.us/water/planning/hab/advisories.json: {updated, advisories: [{waterbody, county, area, date, lifted}]}; the current table shows rows with no lift date. Starred rows: 'Advisory posted by partner agency or HAB confirmed, but no advisory issued'.
cadence: as issued and lifted, May to October
status_reason: Read by this site: the file behind the current-advisories table and the archive (advisories.json: 52 advisories since 2014, 4 in effect on 2026-11-14), with DEQ's posted and lifted days.

name: EPA SOBE (eRule) extract, Arkansas rows
status_reason: EPA's sewer overflow and bypass extracts dated 2026-11-12 (current and all versions) hold no Arkansas rows; DEQ publishes its own search instead.

name: Little Rock Water Reclamation Authority SSO Response Plan (Sierra Club settlement) and overflow reporting line
waters_covered: Fourche Creek, Arkansas River, Rock Creek (Little Rock)
access_detail: The 2004 compliance letter describes an SSO Response Plan with "Signage/Public Notification/Public Information" developed under the Sierra Club settlement; a 2023 certification of final compliance closed the program (339 overflow locations mitigated since 2006). Public reporting line 501-223-1509. No public overflow list found.

name: Arkansas swimming beach monitoring
operator: Arkansas Department of Health; US Army Corps of Engineers lake offices
access_detail: No state bacteria beach-monitoring program found (inland state, not a BEACH Act state). Corps lake swim beaches are managed by district offices.
status_reason: The 2026-11-03 'no beach program' finding was wrong: the Department of Health runs the Arkansas Swim Beach Program (ar-adh-swim-beach-status).

name: Arkansas Department of Health, Arkansas Swim Beach Program: closed swim beaches
operator: Arkansas Department of Health, Marine Sanitation Program
waters_covered: public and private swim beaches (Corps of Engineers, state park, Forest Service and private); the list names beaches, not waters
access_detail: Page answered the identified client 200 on 2026-11-14 (a 403 to the 2026-11-09 research). Under 'Closed Swim Beaches' it lists 'SB112 - Jefferson Ridge West' (one beach); no dates, no reason, no water, no point. E. coli standard: a sample above 126 per 100 ml triggers daily resampling.
legal_basis: Rules Pertaining to Outdoor Bathing Places (ADH)
status_reason: Read by this site as a standing list: each listed beach is a closure from the first read that lists it until a read no longer does.
notes: The beach's water and point are not given and no GNIS feature of the name was found: the record is listed unplaced until a cited point is added.

status_reason: The host refuses this site's identified client (403); a barrier to record, not something to get around.

name: Arkansas DEQ SEEK complaints search

access_detail: Landing page read by the 2026-11-09 research; results not extracted. A complaint is the public's report, not a confirmed discharge; the search would show what staff found.
status_reason: Possible corroboration of overflows missing from the incident search; the public's complaints carry names and addresses and need a safe-field review before any reading.
